attribution.changes: Report metadata arranged into a catalogue. Recommendations and entity responses reproduce source text, with text-layer layout simplified. Each PDF unit retains its PDF page reference. No model summaries.
attribution.exceptions: HTML pages and PDF imprint and third-party notices checked per report. Uncleared PDF bodies and pages without usable text layers are held. Images and logos are excluded.
attribution.endorsement: No endorsement by the State of Queensland or Queensland Audit Office is implied.

limitations: PDF bodies are staged locally for KB review; no KB publication by this loader.
Unparsed recommendation sections and unattributed response pages are recorded in per-report extraction holds.
Signatories remain only inside verbatim response text. No person entities, fields or joins.
